message.noJobsToReview: Rumoured voyages that've been promoted will appear here. Hoist trinkets aboard in th' crow's nest to get started.

message.rejectInfo: Pressin' 'Shuffle Anew' will vary trinket position an' rotation as part o' a new forge voyage. Some trinkets may be scuttled or added durin' th' shuffle.

provisional.name: Rumoured
provisional.tooltip:
Voyage be in a rumoured state an' will be settled when:
  • more trinkets be added to fill th' voyage
  • a suitable contraption be about to be free to forge it
Th' voyage can also be promoted to a settled state by hand.

rejected.name: Cast Off
rejected.tooltip: Th' voyage were cast off an' th' trinkets sent back in line.

sendingFailed.name: Sendin' sunk
sendingFailed.tooltip:
Th' forge voyage went down when sendin' to th' contraption.

This could be caused by th' contraption goin' offline or th' haul line o' waitin' bein' full with too little memory left.

sendingToPrinter.name: Sendin' to contraption
sendingToPrinter.tooltip: Th' forge layers be bein' sent to th' contraption.

slicing.name: Slicin' forge voyage
slicing.tooltip: Th' forge layers be bein' prepared.

slicingFailed.name: Slicin' sunk
slicingFailed.tooltip:
Th' forge voyage went down whilst preparin' th' forge layers.

This could be caused by trouble with th' trinket scrolls.

title.rejectJob: Shuffle th' cast off voyage anew?

tooltips.accepted: All th' voyages taken aboard be shown here, alongside their standin'.
tooltips.provisional:
This shows th' expected upcomin' voyages based on contraption availability, chart compatibility an' unforged trinkets in th' Funnel.

Promotin' 'em will create a settled forge voyage includin' th' identified trinkets, layout an' target contraption. When supports have been generated fer settled voyages, they'll appear in th' 'To Inspect' tab.
tooltips.rejected: All th' voyages that've been cast off be shown here.
tooltips.resendJob: Resend a voyage to a contraption. Handy if th' voyage were belayed or th' contraption hit a blunder.
tooltips.toReview: Forge voyages ready to inspect be shown here. Take 'em aboard to send to th' contraption.
